X509::version
       Returns the version number of an X509 certificate.

SYNOPSIS
       X509::version CERTIFICATE

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the version number of the specified X509 certificate (an integer).

       Syntax

       X509::version 

	    * Returns the version number of the specified X509 certificate (an
	      integer).

RETURN VALUE
       Returns the version number of an X509 certificate.

VALID DURING
       ANY_EVENT

EXAMPLES
	when HTTP_REQUEST {
	  log local0. "Cert version - [X509::version ssl_cert]"
	  if { [X509::version ssl_cert] eq 3 } {
	    pool v3_pool
	  } else {
	    pool default_pool
	  }
	}

HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-9.0.0 --First introduced the command.
